description: Ayuntamiento de Bilbao: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Bilbao. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Bilbao. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Calles de Bilbao; Aparcamientos Municipales para Residentes; Noticias de temas de Aparcamientos; Cámaras de tráfico de Bilbao en tiempo real. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/es). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
